decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Separate access to the residential accommodation on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents at all times.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8am  to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am  to 12pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, before the development is commenced, for a scheme of acoustic insulation to ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within dwellings with windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS8233:1999 these being LAeq,16hour = 30 dB in living rooms, and LAeq,8hour = 30 dB and LAFMAX = 45 dB in bedrooms. Before any part of the development is first occupied or used the scheme must be completed".
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the ground floor shop, alterations to existing shop front to provide a seperate access to the first floor to create a self contained flat and erection of rear roof extension incorporating one rooflight to the front elevation.
